ABOUT BLACK DOG FARM

Black Dog Farm is a pasture-based pork and poultry farm located in beautiful Livingston, Montana. The farm was borne out of a desire to provide nutritious, delicious food for our family from animals that truly live a good life. Years and years ago, we struggled to find locally and ethically raised pork and poultry and could not consciously eat meat from animals raised in confined commercialized operations. Four laying hens and a trio of breeding pigs morphed into this thriving business that provides healthy, amazingly tasty food for the community we love. Established in 2017 the farm is owned and managed by Tim & Kira, a husband and wife team, along with our dogs, cats, and little girl, Dottie. 

At Black Dog Farm, we work hard every day to raise meat & eggs from animals shown respect and dignity every day of their lives. Our animals live outdoors, rotating around our farm inside portable fencing. Our pigs, laying hens, and meat chickens eat a corn, soy, and GMO free feed of barley, peas, wheat, camelina, and species-specific organic minerals, enzymes, and amino acids. Our feed is grown and milled within an hour of our farm by Highland Harmony Farms, and we are really proud to support their grain business with our farm. We employ a team of livestock guardian dogs to keep both our animals, and our resident predators, safe -- allowing everyone to exist in the same space. We believe raising animals outdoors on pasture, where they can express their natural behaviors, produces healthier, tastier food and is better for the animals, better for the environment, and better for us. We are strong advocates of the local food movement, supporting other hyper-local farmers, ranchers, and producers in our own home and encouraging people all over the country to find a farm nearby to shop from. We are proud of the food we produce and are amazed at the creativity and variety of other local food producers here in SW Montana.

Currently, we produce eggs, pork, chicken, duck, and a little lamb. Our meat chicken season is seasonal, generally running from April-October each year. Our laying hens are at their highest production in the spring and early summer, and our pigs go to butcher year round. We raise 2 groups of meat ducks each year -- probably our favorite species on the farm. Our days and brains are full. We are shocked by all we have learned and continue to learn. We can't believe where we are today and we are always striving to improve. We are also continually blown away by the support of our community and people's enthusiasm and interest in what we are doing. We are so honored to raise your food.

WHERE TO FIND OUR FOOD
FARMERS MARKETS

We attend farmers markets in Bozeman year-round. We bring a good stock of all of our products to the markets. Because of logistics and cooler space, we cannot bring online orders to the markets for pick up. But you can almost always come get what you need at the markets.

Find us at the Bozeman Winter Farmers Market from October-May

From June-September you can find us:

at the Bozeman Farmers Market on Tuesday evenings

and at the Gallatin Valley Farmers Market on Saturday mornings.

ORDER ONLINE FOR DELIVERY OR ON FARM PICK UP

You can place an order by clicking "Shop The Farm" at the top of this page. Everything we currently have in stock is available in our online store, including some things we don't have room to bring to the markets like organs and bones.

Home Delivery: we will deliver to your home in Bozeman, Belgrade, Four Corners, Big Sky, and Livingston (within town). There is free delivery with a $100 order minimum. We deliver every Wednesday and you can choose Local Delivery at check out. If you live outside of these areas (Park County, Three Forks, etc.) you can schedule an on farm pick up. If you have a question about whether you are within our delivery radius, just send us an email!

On Farm Pick Up: you can choose an available day and time slot for an on farm pick up at check out. There is no minimum order for picking up at the farm. We have a pick up cooler and you will receive an e-mail with directions and confirmation that your order is ready to pick up at the start of your pick up window. Sometimes we get caught up with emergencies or farm tasks, so please wait for the "ready to pick up" email before heading out to the farm.

ORDER A BOX OF CHICKEN TO BE SHIPPED TO YOUR HOUSE

Do you live outside Park or Gallatin counties but still in Montana? We will ship a box of chicken to you! We ship on Mondays and Tuesdays, and your order will arrive with dry ice on your doorstep in 24-48 hours. We have multiple options that include Whole Chickens, Chicken Bone Broth, and Chicken Pieces. Check out the options here.

OTHER BUSINESSES THAT SUPPORT OUR FARM

Little Star Diner: arguably the best restaurant in Bozeman, we are so proud of our long standing relationship with these phenomenal folks. Beyond committed to local sourcing, Little Star Diner is truly one of a kind. We provide them with chicken, duck, pork, and eggs. If you haven't been, go tonight.

Woods Rose Market: your local stop for all things local and delicious, Woods Rose is a nursery and garden center with an adorable store stocked with local meats, cheeses, dairy, vegetables, and other products like pastas, sauces, chocolate, and household goods. They stock a good selection of our chicken products. Definitely a must visit.

Mischa's: a fine natural wine store with a curated selection of food products, as well as a local meat freezer, Mischa's is a gem in North Bozeman. In addition to a wide variety of all-natural wines, they also have fun items like curries, seasonings, tinned fish, crackers, snacks, oils and vinegars, and so much more. They keep a rotating selection of our products in their fridges, often including eggs!

Yellowstone Valley Food Hub: for those of you in the Billings area, the YVFH often has our chicken in stock along with tons of other local products. They have a storefront in Billings and also offer multiple drop points for orders.

ANNOUNCING FALL FARM CLUB

FARM CLUB IS A ONCE PER MONTH, FULLY CUSTOMIZABLE CSA THAT GETS YOU EXACTLY WHAT YOU WANT AT A DISCOUNT.
FALL FARM CLUB IS FULL!

The Details:

Each month from October-January, you will be sent a form to fill out with options for your CSA for that month. Farm Club is available in 2 sizes, small and large. You can elect to pick up your CSA at the farm, at the farmers market on Saturday in Bozeman, or you can choose to have it delivered for $30 for all 4 months.

SMALL CSA: $650 (save $20-30 PLUS get $10 FREE MEAT every month)

2 dozen eggs
10-13 pounds of meat - you choose your meat! This is enough for about 5-10 meals depending on how many people you're cooking for.
Black Dog Farm tote bag for your CSA

LARGE CSA: $1,299 (save $40-60 PLUS get $25 FREE MEAT every month)

4 dozen eggs
17-20 pounds of meat - you choose your meat! This is enough for about 5-15 meals depending on how many people you're cooking for.
Black Dog Farm tote bag for your CSA

WHY CSA? WHY NOW?

CSAs are one of the most important aspects of our farm. The popularity and feedback we received after launching Farm Club this summer has led us to offer a Fall Farm Club! For you, purchasing a Farm Club share saves you money and fills your freezer with delicious, nutritious local meat and eggs.

RESERVE YOUR 2026 WHOLE OR HALF HOG

Now taking deposits for spring 2026. The most delicious pork from the happiest, healthiest pigs.

A COLLABORATION BETWEEN FARMER & CUSTOMER

Purchasing a whole or half hog from us is a collaborative process in which you, the customer, play an important role. While we, the farmers, raise, feed, and care for the pigs, you are responsible for deciding what you want the final product to look like. Once we drop your pig off at the butcher, you step in and take it from there. That means conversing with the butcher to get your questions answered and make sure you are getting the exact cuts, sausages, and cured items you want. Want your chops extra thick and bone-in or thin and boneless? Do you want smaller roasts to feed a couple or 5+ pound roasts for a big family? Do you want fresh pork belly for tacos or rice bowls, or cured sliced bacon for weekend breakfasts? Do you want chorizo, Italian, or breakfast sausage, or do you want to go with all plain ground pork? These are all decisions you will get to make, ensuring you get exactly what you want. And while we take your pig to the processor, you will have the experience of picking up your custom cut whole or half hog directly from the butcher.

If you've had our pork, you know it stands out. We raise a heritage cross breed of meat pigs that produce the most delicious, dark marbled pork you've ever seen. Our pigs are raised on our farm and are fed a custom feed of Montana grown grains and legumes, organic mineral, and supplemental amino acids. All of our feed is ground fresh on the farm and is free of corn and soy. Our pigs spend their lives outdoors, absorbing tons of Vitamin D, rooting, grazing, wallowing, and lounging. They are happy and healthy, and truly produce the very best pork. For the first time in a number of years we are offering whole & half hogs for sale. We have compiled a number of infographics below so that you can understand the process and your role in it. These pigs are currently just-weaned piglets and will spend the next 6 months being pigs and living the good life. We are reserving only a portion of our pigs to sell as wholes and halves, so reserve yours now for harvest in May 2026.

Scroll to the bottom of the page to reserve your pork! After reading the information, of course.

WHY PURCHASE A WHOLE OR HALF?

There's a reason we get so many requests for whole and half hogs. First, it's a deal! You will save $2-$20 per pound depending on the cut (so much savings on bacon!!). Second, you get to choose exactly what you want. Don't want roasts? Great - have them ground or made into steaks. Want tons of breakfast sausage? Easy to do! Third, cooking meals from freezer storage is so convenient. Don't know what to make for dinner or meal prep? Take a look at what you have in the freezer and start there!

Why reserve your whole or half now? To help raise YOUR pig! Over the next 6 months, we will feed and care for your pig. Reserving now helps us plan AND helps with the costs of growing your pork.
